subtitle: Learn country lead guitar including chicken picking, hybrid picking, and Telecaster-style phrasing.

introduction.title: Country Lead Guitar: Twang Meets Technique
introduction.text: Country lead guitar is built around the bright, articulate sound of the Fender Telecaster. Clean, percussive attack and precise technique are essential. Country lead emphasizes clean execution and musical taste over speed or complexity.

columns.title: The Telecaster Sound
columns.text: Core Elements: Hybrid picking, string bending, major pentatonic scales, clean articulation

columns.title: Precision and Clarity
columns.text: Philosophy: Technical proficiency serves the song, not the other way around. Melody and groove are paramount.

cards.title: Chicken Picking
cards.description: Hybrid picking technique combining pick and fingers for distinctive attack

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Alternate between pick attack and finger plucking for percussive, country sound

fields.label: Technique Detail
fields.value: Use pick for down beats, middle finger for upbeats and accents

fields.label: Key Players
fields.value: Albert Lee, Brad Paisley, Keith Urban

fields.label: Practice
fields.value: Practice scales alternating pick and finger attacks

cards.title: Hybrid Picking
cards.description: Using pick and fingers simultaneously for complex patterns

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Play multiple strings at once, create arpeggiated patterns with control

fields.label: Technique Detail
fields.value: Pick + middle and ring fingers, various combinations

fields.label: Key Players
fields.value: Chet Atkins, Tommy Emmanuel, Jerry Reed

fields.label: Practice
fields.value: Practice playing melody with pick while fingers play harmony

cards.title: Telecaster-Style Bending
cards.description: Characteristic string bending associated with Telecaster guitars

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Quick, precise bends with immediate release, often on higher strings

fields.label: Technique Detail
fields.value: Use multiple fingers for support, focus on accuracy

fields.label: Key Players
fields.value: James Burton, Don Rich, Brent Mason

fields.label: Practice
fields.value: Practice bending G string (3rd fret) up whole step with quick release

cards.title: Pedal Steel Emulation
cards.description: Guitar techniques that mimic pedal steel guitar sounds

fields.label: Application
fields.value: Volume swells, slides, and bends that create steel guitar-like effects

fields.label: Technique Detail
fields.value: Use volume knob, string bending, and slide techniques

fields.label: Key Players
fields.value: Jerry Donahue, Danny Gatton, Albert Lee

fields.label: Practice
fields.value: Practice volume swells combined with string bending

cards.title: Major Pentatonic
cards.description: Foundation of country lead playing, works over most major progressions

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G major pentatonic: G-A-B-D-E

fields.label: Country Context
fields.value: Chicken picking, fast runs, happy melodies

cards.title: Mixolydian Mode
cards.description: Over dominant 7th chords, country-rock, Southern rock

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G Mixolydian: G-A-B-C-D-E-F

fields.label: Country Context
fields.value: Adds bluesy flavor to major progressions

cards.title: Country Minor Pentatonic
cards.description: Creates major/minor ambiguity, very country-specific sound

fields.label: Degrees
fields.value: 1-b3-4-5-b7 (with added major 3rd)

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G minor pentatonic + B natural

fields.label: Country Context
fields.value: Classic country blues, honky-tonk style

cards.title: Major Scale
cards.description: For more sophisticated country harmony, ballads

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G major: G-A-B-C-D-E-F#

fields.label: Country Context
fields.value: Modern country, country-pop crossover

cards.title: I-V-vi-IV Progression
cards.description: Use major pentatonic as foundation, add passing tones from major scale

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G-D-Em-C

fields.label: Best Scales
fields.value: G major pentatonic, G major scale

fields.label: Songs
fields.value: "Friends in Low Places", "Cruise", many modern country hits

cards.title: I-IV-V Progression
cards.description: Classic three-chord country, emphasize major pentatonic

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G-C-D-G

fields.label: Best Scales
fields.value: G major pentatonic, G Mixolydian

fields.label: Songs
fields.value: "Honky Tonk Blues", "Your Cheatin' Heart", traditional country

cards.title: ii-V-I Country
cards.description: More jazz-influenced, but with country phrasing and techniques

fields.label: Example
fields.value: Am-D-G

fields.label: Best Scales
fields.value: A Dorian, D Mixolydian, G major

fields.label: Songs
fields.value: "He Stopped Loving Her Today", country ballads

cards.title: I-bVII-IV Progression
cards.description: Use Mixolydian mode to handle the bVII chord

fields.label: Example
fields.value: G-F-C-G

fields.label: Best Scales
fields.value: G Mixolydian, G major pentatonic

fields.label: Songs
fields.value: "Sweet Home Alabama" influence in country

fields.value: James Burton, Don Rich, Roy Nichols

cards.title: Country Blues
cards.description: Blues influence in country context, minor pentatonic usage

fields.label: Key Players

cards.title: Classic Telecaster Bend
cards.description: Quick whole-step bend on G string with immediate release

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Bend 3rd fret G string up to 5th fret pitch, release quickly

fields.label: Usage
fields.value: End of phrases, turnarounds, classic country punctuation

fields.label: Variation
fields.value: Can be done with pre-bend, or combined with open strings

cards.title: Chicken Pickin' Run
cards.description: Fast major pentatonic run using hybrid picking

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Alternate pick and middle finger attacks for percussive sound

fields.label: Usage
fields.value: Fast passages, fills between vocal lines, showing off

fields.label: Variation
fields.value: Can be played with different rhythmic subdivisions

cards.title: Open String Pull-off
cards.description: Pull-off to open strings for bright, ringing sound

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Fret note, pull off to open string for country brightness

fields.label: Usage
fields.value: Creates classic country "jangle", works in many contexts

fields.label: Variation
fields.value: Combine with hammer-ons for flowing passages

cards.title: Pedal Steel Simulation
cards.description: Volume swell combined with string bending

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Use volume knob to create swell while bending strings

fields.label: Usage
fields.value: Ballads, emotional passages, mimicking pedal steel guitar

fields.label: Variation
fields.value: Can be combined with slide techniques

cards.title: Basic Hybrid Picking
cards.description: Use pick for bass strings, middle finger for treble strings. Start slowly with simple patterns. Foundation for all country lead techniques.

cards.title: Chicken Picking
cards.description: Aggressive finger attack creates percussive "pop" sound. Use for fast passages and accents. Signature country sound, requires practice for clean execution.

cards.title: Advanced Patterns
cards.description: Use pick + multiple fingers for complex arpeggios and fast scalar passages. Allows for incredible speed and precision when mastered.

practiceSection.title: Country Lead Practice Routine
items: Hybrid Picking: Practice basic hybrid picking patterns. Start with scales, progress to arpeggios and complex patterns.
String Bending: Practice precise string bending with quick release. Focus on accuracy and clean execution.
Country Licks: Learn classic country licks and practice them in different keys and contexts.
Song Application: Apply techniques to real country songs. Focus on serving the song rather than showing off.
